name: Gijs van Lennep
features: fair hair, patrician Dutch features, easy aristocratic manner, tall build
bio: The Dutch jonkheer who drove the Finnish AAW team's 908/02 in 1970 and won Le Mans outright the following year in the Martini 917K with Helmut Marko, setting a distance record that stood for thirty-nine years. Won it again in 1976 for Porsche.
